    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Winner validity for decisive results
    decisive_mask = league_df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets'])
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((~decisive_mask) | (league_df['winner'].notna() & ((league_df['winner'] == league_df['team1']) | (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team2'])))).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    # No result implies no winner
    no_result_mask = league_df['result'].eq('no result')
    # Super over matches are ties
    so_mask = df['super_over'].eq('Y')

    dl_mask = df['method'].eq('D/L')

    toss_wins = (
        df.groupby(['season', 'toss_winner'])
          .size()
          .reset_index(name='toss_wins')
          .rename(columns={'toss_winner': 'team'})
    )

    # Standings from League stage
    league_df['is_win'] = decisive_mask
    # Derive loser for decisive matches
    league_df['loser'] = np.where(
        league_df['winner'] == league_df['team1'], league_df['team2'],
        np.where(league_df['winner'] == league_df['team2'], league_df['team1'], np.nan)
    )

    # Expand team list by season to ensure every team appears in standings
    teams_season = pd.concat([
        league_df[['season', 'team1']].rename(columns={'team1': 'team'}),
        league_df[['season', 'team2']].rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})
    ], ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates()

    # Wins
    wins = (league_df.loc[league_df['is_win'], ['season', 'winner']]
                    .rename(columns={'winner': 'team'})
                    .assign(wins=1)
                    .groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['wins'].sum())

    # Losses
    losses = (league_df.loc[league_df['is_win'], ['season', 'loser']]
                      .rename(columns={'loser': 'team'})
                      .assign(losses=1)
                      .groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['losses'].sum())

    # Ties -> 1 point to each team
    ties_df = league_df.loc[league_df['result'].eq('tie'), ['season', 'team1', 'team2']]
    ties_long = pd.concat([
        ties_df[['season', 'team1']].rename(columns={'team1': 'team'}),
        ties_df[['season', 'team2']].rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})
    ], ignore_index=True)
    ties = ties_long.assign(ties=1).groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['ties'].sum()

    # No results -> 1 point to each team
    nrs_df = league_df.loc[league_df['result'].eq('no result'), ['season', 'team1', 'team2']]
    nrs_long = pd.concat([
        nrs_df[['season', 'team1']].rename(columns={'team1': 'team'}),
        nrs_df[['season', 'team2']].rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})
    ], ignore_index=True)
    no_results = nrs_long.assign(no_results=1).groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['no_results'].sum()

    # Merge all metrics
    standings = teams_season.merge(wins, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(losses, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(ties, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(no_results, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(toss_wins, on=['season', 'team'], how='left')

    for col in ['wins', 'losses', 'ties', 'no_results', 'toss_wins']:
        standings[col] = standings[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    standings['matches'] = standings[['wins', 'losses', 'ties', 'no_results']].sum(axis=1)
    standings['points'] = (2 * standings['wins']) + (1 * standings['ties']) + (1 * standings['no_results'])

    # Rank within season: points desc, wins desc, fewer toss wins (ascending), then team name asc
    standings['rank'] = standings.sort_values(['season', 'points', 'wins', 'toss_wins', 'team'],
                                              ascending=[True, False, False, True, True]) \
                                 .groupby('season') \
                                 .cumcount() + 1

    # Determine top-4 seeds for playoffs
    seeds = standings.loc[standings['rank'] <= 4, ['season', 'team', 'rank']].rename(columns={'rank': 'seed'})

    # Validate Final presence per season
    final_counts = df.assign(is_final=df['match_type'].eq('Final')).groupby('season', as_index=False)['is_final'].sum()
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (final_counts['is_final'] == 1).all()

    # Extract playoff outcomes from actual matches
    playoffs = df[df['match_type'].isin(['Eliminator', 'Elimination Final', 'Qualifier 1', 'Qualifier 2', 'Semi Final', 'Final', '3rd Place Play-Off'])].copy()

    # Map winners for each playoff stage per season
    playoff_results = (playoffs[['season', 'match_type', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner']]
                       .copy())

    # For reporting, ensure winners of decisive playoff matches are within participating teams when applicable
    dec_playoff_mask = playoff_results['match_type'].ne('3rd Place Play-Off')

    assert ( (~dec_playoff_mask) | valid_winner_in_match ).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    p2 = p1.merge(seeds.rename(columns={'team': 'team2', 'seed': 'team2_seed'}), on=['season', 'team2'], how='left')

    return standings, p2, champions

        df.groupby(['season', 'toss_winner'])
          .size()
          .reset_index(name='toss_wins')
          .rename(columns={'toss_winner': 'team'})
    )

    # Standings from League stage
    league_df['is_win'] = decisive_mask
    # Derive loser for decisive matches
    league_df['loser'] = np.where(
        league_df['winner'] == league_df['team1'], league_df['team2'],
        np.where(league_df['winner'] == league_df['team2'], league_df['team1'], np.nan)
    )

    # Expand team list by season to ensure every team appears in standings
    teams_season = pd.concat([
        league_df[['season', 'team1']].rename(columns={'team1': 'team'}),
        league_df[['season', 'team2']].rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})
    ], ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates()

    # Wins
    wins = (league_df.loc[league_df['is_win'], ['season', 'winner']]
                    .rename(columns={'winner': 'team'})
                    .assign(wins=1)
                    .groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['wins'].sum())

    # Losses
    losses = (league_df.loc[league_df['is_win'], ['season', 'loser']]
                      .rename(columns={'loser': 'team'})
                      .assign(losses=1)
                      .groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['losses'].sum())

    # Ties -> 1 point to each team
    ties_df = league_df.loc[league_df['result'].eq('tie'), ['season', 'team1', 'team2']]
    ties_long = pd.concat([
        ties_df[['season', 'team1']].rename(columns={'team1': 'team'}),
        ties_df[['season', 'team2']].rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})
    ], ignore_index=True)
    ties = ties_long.assign(ties=1).groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['ties'].sum()

    # No results -> 1 point to each team
    nrs_df = league_df.loc[league_df['result'].eq('no result'), ['season', 'team1', 'team2']]
    nrs_long = pd.concat([
        nrs_df[['season', 'team1']].rename(columns={'team1': 'team'}),
        nrs_df[['season', 'team2']].rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})
    ], ignore_index=True)
    no_results = nrs_long.assign(no_results=1).groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)['no_results'].sum()

    # Merge all metrics
    standings = teams_season.merge(wins, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(losses, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(ties, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(no_results, on=['season', 'team'], how='left') \
                             .merge(toss_wins, on=['season', 'team'], how='left')

    for col in ['wins', 'losses', 'ties', 'no_results', 'toss_wins']:
        standings[col] = standings[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    standings['matches'] = standings[['wins', 'losses', 'ties', 'no_results']].sum(axis=1)
    standings['points'] = (2 * standings['wins']) + (1 * standings['ties']) + (1 * standings['no_results'])

    # Rank within season: points desc, wins desc, fewer toss wins (ascending), then team name asc
    standings['rank'] = standings.sort_values(['season', 'points', 'wins', 'toss_wins', 'team'],
                                              ascending=[True, False, False, True, True]) \
                                 .groupby('season') \
                                 .cumcount() + 1

    # Determine top-4 seeds for playoffs
    seeds = standings.loc[standings['rank'] <= 4, ['season', 'team', 'rank']].rename(columns={'rank': 'seed'})

    # Validate Final presence per season
    final_counts = df.assign(is_final=df['match_type'].eq('Final')).groupby('season', as_index=False)['is_final'].sum()
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (final_counts['is_final'] == 1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Extract playoff outcomes from actual matches
    playoffs = df[df['match_type'].isin(['Eliminator', 'Elimination Final', 'Qualifier 1', 'Qualifier 2', 'Semi Final', 'Final', '3rd Place Play-Off'])].copy()

    # Map winners for each playoff stage per season
    playoff_results = (playoffs[['season', 'match_type', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner']]
                       .copy())

    # For reporting, ensure winners of decisive playoff matches are within participating teams when applicable
    dec_playoff_mask = playoff_results['match_type'].ne('3rd Place Play-Off')
    # ASSERTION_START
# If a winner exists, it must be one of the participating teams.
winner_is_participant = (playoff_results['winner'].isna()) | \
                        (playoff_results['winner'] == playoff_results['team1']) | \
                        (playoff_results['winner'] == playoff_results['team2'])

# The 'Final' must have a non-null winner to correctly identify the season champion.
final_has_winner = (playoff_results['match_type'] != 'Final') | \
                   (playoff_results['winner'].notna())

assert (winner_is_participant & final_has_winner).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    champions = playoff_results[playoff_results['match_type'] == 'Final'][['season', 'winner']] \
        .rename(columns={'winner': 'champion'})

    # For transparency, include seeds with playoff participants
    # Merge seeds onto playoff participants to see seed vs path
    p1 = playoff_results.merge(seeds.rename(columns={'team': 'team1', 'seed': 'team1_seed'}), on=['season', 'team1'], how='left')
    p2 = p1.merge(seeds.rename(columns={'team': 'team2', 'seed': 'team2_seed'}), on=['season', 'team2'], how='left')

    return standings, p2, champions


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_path = Path(args.input)
    output_path = Path(args.output)
    output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_path / 'previous_data.csv')

    standings, playoffs_with_seeds, champions = compute_standings_and_playoffs(df)

    standings.sort_values(['season', 'rank', 'team']).to_csv(output_path / 'season_standings.csv', index=False)
    playoffs_with_seeds.sort_values(['season', 'match_type']).to_csv(output_path / 'playoffs_outcomes.csv', index=False)
    champions.sort_values('season').to_csv(output_path / 'champions.csv', index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
